page: Microsoft Azure L16as_v5 is a storage and memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Lasv5 server family. Powered by an AMD x86_64 processor, this instance features 16 dedicated vCPUs and is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

A key feature of the L16as_v5 is its integrated local storage, consisting of 3840 GB of NVMe SSD. This substantial local storage capacity is Premium Storage capable, enabling high-throughput and low-latency data access directly on the host. The instance does not include any bundled GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high ratio of NVMe SSD storage and memory relative to the 16 dedicated vCPUs, the L16as_v5 offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring large local scratch space or fast caching layers without the overhead of external storage attachments. This configuration is highly suitable for relational and non-relational databases, data warehousing, large-scale analytics, and transactional applications that demand high I/O performance and significant memory capacity.
